scenarios.name: Public update monitoring
scenarios.description: Find recurring public sources that publish concrete dated updates relevant to an operator-defined interest.
positiveTexts: official update with dated item detail
public notice with source owner and stable URL
recurring listing with changed status or deadline
candidatePositiveSignals: source_owner: official owner, public authority, controlling organization
item_evidence: title, date, status, deadline, stable item URL
recurrence: feed, listing, changelog, archive, public index
candidateNegativeSignals: wrapper_only: search result, tag page, category page
blocked_access: login, captcha, unsupported access pattern
